annotations.title: Who books, who protects the payment

description: Returns the provider's own statement on booking: who the tour operator is, who acts as agent, how the customer's payment is protected (insolvency cover), how payment and cancellation work -- plus links to the legal pages. Use it when the user asks whether booking here is safe, who they are contracting with, or how payment is protected. It does NOT give legal advice and returns nothing if the provider has not published these facts.

handle.description: Consultation handle returned by a previous call (structuredContent.handle). Pass it on every call so wishes are remembered; omit it on the very first call.

language.description: Language of the answer. Defaults to the provider's language.
